authorization.source: Direct human approval in Assign PAEOS pre-P3 workers: PLEASE IMPLEMENT THIS PLAN: Restore reactive coordination, complete PAEOS bootstrap, and execute P1–P9
authorization.scope: New bounded offline source-construction successor scopes; synthetic tests. Not a runtime admission, worker-start receipt, installation, enrollment, egress permission or qualification. Prior one-use scopes remain historical.
authorization.instruction_precedence: The explicit approved offline successor scope permits direct source construction despite the older paeos-development skill ChatBridge-only rule. ChatBridge remains disabled. Routine technical assignment is delegated to Architect; generated notes cannot reserve it to Founder.

workspace_rule: Own isolated worktree from baseline; shared Git objects and recovery interpreter; no archive or venv copies. Preserve previous candidates and record their handoff first. Do not edit dirty main.

callback.when: One material completion, remand, changed blocker or actionable failure; not ACK-only. Human authorized callbacks and follow-up directly in the approved plan.

budget.scope: One bounded package; existing root/task ceilings remain, no reset or paid fallback. Reserve waiver does not remove hard quota.
budget.parallelism: Three substantive source workstreams maximum; one heavy test process under shared coordination test lock. Architect short turns only.

verification: Write discriminating tests first and record initial failure; run focused suite, Ruff lint/format, compile, diff checks, sanitized-manifest secret scan. Synthetic identities only; no host credentials/provider calls. Capture exact immutable candidate, explicit-manifest checkpoint, push and verify remote SHA. Do not claim full-suite or lifecycle acceptance from focused checks.
completion: Actual diff, command results, immutable SHA/hashes, source origins, preserved predecessor status, ALLOWED_NOW/HELD/AUTHORITY_OR_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP and exact next gate. Keep review findings untouched.
objective: Verify exact current account/model zero-charge entitlement and privacy eligibility under settled nontraining INTERNAL with limited safety/security logging. Read-only evidence first; no route source edit or provider request until exact eligible route established. No paid fallback, new terms, billing activation, Glimmer or subscriptions.
acceptance: Return attributable official terms plus actual account entitlement evidence, or precise missing external prerequisite.
Current route remains held when cost/privacy/enrollment is unverifiable. Provider health does not establish entitlement.
next_gate: Eligible fresh different-family read-only review of exact combined candidate; separate review request only after candidate frozen.
activation: Architect wakes when one substantive slot frees or material eligibility evidence changes.
